question: When an activity requires too much effort we feel:
solution:
The correct answer is "**​****frustrated**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **theme **of the comprehension is that one needs **perseverance **and a **patient **attitude to **learn piano **and there are no instant lessons or shortcuts.
 
• In the given comprehension, if we look at the **fifth** line in the **second** paragraph.
 
• It states that "*We get upset, **frustrated**__, and angry when a skill or activity requires us to put in a lot of effort and time*".

**Thus, the correct answer is option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
• **Fulfilled**: satisfied or happy because of fully developing one's abilities or character.
 
• **Frustrated**: feeling or expressing distress and annoyance resulting from an inability to change or achieve something.
 
• **Inspired: **of extraordinary quality, as if arising from some external creative impulse.
 
• **Happy: **feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.
 
 
• **Example**: *She felt **frustrated __**after losing the tennis match.*
